title: Enroll response
description: 201 response to POST /api/v1/enroll. The credential appears here once and nowhere else.

credential.description: Permanent per-host credential, `<key_id>.<secret>`; sent as `Authorization: Bearer <credential>`. Secret: never logged.

host_name.description: Display name the operator gave the host, for the installer's summary. Sent by servers from P1-AGENT-INSTALL on; agents treat it as optional.
